mapper.insert: INSERT INTO xsy_finance_purchase_cost_entry(adjustment_id, receipt_item_id, original_payable_id, amount, created_by) VALUES (#{adjustmentId}, #{receiptItemId}, #{originalPayableId}, #{amount}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS payable_id, p.amount, item.amount AS line_amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(red.amount) FROM xsy_finance_payable red WHERE red.original_payable_id = p.id AND red.entry_type = 'RED' AND red.deleted = FALSE), 0) AS red_amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ri.amount) FROM xsy_finance_payable red JOIN xsy_finance_payable_item ri ON ri.payable_id = red.id AND ri.deleted = FALSE WHERE red.original_payable_id = p.id AND red.entry_type = 'RED' AND red.deleted = FALSE AND ri.purchase_order_item_id = #{orderItemId}), 0) AS line_red_amount FROM xsy_finance_payable p JOIN xsy_finance_payable_item item ON item.payable_id = p.id AND item.purchase_order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND item.deleted = FALSE LEFT JOIN xsy_finance_purchase_cost_entry entry ON p.source_type = 'PURCHASE_COST_ADJUSTMENT' AND entry.id = p.source_id WHERE p.entry_type = 'NORMAL' AND p.deleted = FALSE AND ((p.source_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT' AND p.source_id = #{receiptId} AND item.source_type = 'PURCHASE_RECEIPT_ITEM' AND item.source_id = #{receiptItemId}) OR (p.source_type = 'PURCHASE_COST_ADJUSTMENT' AND entry.receipt_item_id = #{receiptItemId})) ORDER BY p.id FOR UPDATE OF p

SELECT p.id AS payable_id, p.amount, item.amount AS line_amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(red.amount) FROM xsy_finance_payable red WHERE red.original_payable_id = p.id AND red.entry_type = 'RED' AND red.deleted = FALSE), 0) AS red_amount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(ri.amount) FROM xsy_finance_payable red JOIN xsy_finance_payable_item ri ON ri.payable_id = red.id AND ri.deleted = FALSE WHERE red.original_payable_id = p.id AND red.entry_type = 'RED' AND red.deleted = FALSE AND ri.purchase_order_item_id = #{orderItemId}), 0) AS line_red_amount FROM xsy_finance_payable p JOIN xsy_finance_payable_item item ON item.payable_id = p.id AND item.purchase_order_item_id = #{orderItemId} AND item.deleted = FALSE WHERE p.id = #{payableId} AND p.deleted = FALSE AND p.entry_type = 'NORMAL'
